status_summary: DERA published six reports on 2025-04-28, including updated statistics on exempt offerings under Regulations A, D and Crowdfunding through 2024. The SEC launched a statistics and data visualization webpage on 2025-08-13; as read on 2026-10-18 it lists 26 series on capital formation, market participants, market activity and investors, most capital formation series updated 2026-09-22. None of these includes enforcement data, violations or regulatory cost series, or an annual data book, and no change allowing three Commissioners to set the agenda was found.

timeline.event: The SEC announces that DERA published six reports on public issuers, exempt offerings, CMBS, ABS, money market funds and security-based swap dealers, including yearly series on exempt offerings through 2024.

The SEC launches a statistics and data visualization webpage, produced by DERA, covering IPOs, exempt offerings, bond offerings, reporting issuers and other series with time series charts and a downloadable table.

title: SEC data book from DERA and three-commissioner agenda power
uncertainties: The SEC statistics page was read in this review on sec.gov and lists 26 series with update dates through 2026-09-22 and no enforcement, violations or regulatory cost series and no data book; the two 2025 press releases were read in full by the researcher. The exempt offerings report is an update of an existing DERA series, so part of the 2025 publication continues earlier practice. No search was run for internal SEC procedures on agenda setting, which are rarely public, so that element rests on absence of evidence. The Division of Enforcement's own annual results were not reviewed, and other DERA releases in 2026 were not enumerated.
